title: Introduction to eppoFindeR
text: primary functionality eppoFindeR query EPPO database specific EPPO codes retrieve data across various services. Users can either choose : 1) query single service given EPPO code 2) query available services database comprehensive information. plant pest species, basic available information includes scientific names, synonyms, common names different languages, taxonomic position. pest regulatory interest, detailed information can also retrieved regarding host plants categorization (quarantine status). examples guide use functions package access data, begin, need load eppoFindeR package command: want learn arguments usage particular function, can simply run: help("function_name") display detailed documentation function, including arguments, return values, examples. example, ’re working function called queryTheEPPOForService(), use: help("queryTheEPPOForService")

title: Introduction to eppoFindeR
text: eppoFindeR package also provides data wrangling function, taxonomyRanked(), can combine data fetched “taxonomy” “kingdom” EPPO services create unified, integrated dataframe. example, assume two dataframes: taxonomy kingdom, obtained querying “taxonomy” “kingdom” services EPPO code “BEMITA” using queryTheEPPOForService() function. can combine two dataframes follows:
code: # Query the taxonomy service for the EPPO code "BEMITA" taxonomy <- queryTheEPPOForService("BEMITA", service = "taxonomy")  # Query the kingdom service for the EPPO code "BEMITA" kingdom <- queryTheEPPOForService("BEMITA", service = "kingdom")  # Combine taxonomy and kingdom data wrangled_data <- taxonomyRanked(taxonomy, kingdom)

title: Introduction to eppoFindeR
text: wrangled_data dataframe combines taxonomy kingdom information EPPO code “BEMITA”. integration provides comprehensive view organism’s taxonomic rank. Specifically, output dataframe contains following columns: rank: taxonomic rank. codeid: unique identifier entry. eppocode: EPPO code representing taxonomic group. prefname: preferred name taxonomic group (e.g., “Animalia”, “Insecta”). level: taxonomic level hierarchy (1 broadest category, progressing specific levels). queriedEppocode: input EPPO code. queriedOn: date query performed. queriedUrl: queried URL.

text: 'eppoFindeR' package provides wrap around European Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization ('EPPO') database public 'APIs'. enables users retrieve 'EPPO'-related data searches across entire 'EPPO' database utilizing specific services, including categorization, taxonomy, . package also includes data wrangling function integrate taxonomy rank information, function returns list member countries Regional Plant Protection Organization acronym used 'EPPO' database.
